facts.business: Pharmaids Pharmaceuticals Limited is a listed public company transitioning to build a world-class Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organization (CRDMO) offering end-to-end services to pharma, biopharma, agro-chemicals, medical devices, and specialty chemicals industries.
key_risks: Ability to successfully implement strategy and growth and expansion plans
General economic and political conditions in India
Changes in laws and regulations applicable to the industry
facts.related_party_note: Significant related party transactions include unsecured loans borrowed from Adita Bio Sys Private Limited (₹777 Lakhs), Dr. S N Vinaya Babu (₹647.15 Lakhs), and Moki Financial Services (₹67 Lakhs) as at 31 March 2026. The Company also disinvested its 66.50% partnership interest in Anugraha Chemicals during the year, resulting in a receivable of ₹262.5 Lakhs.
